verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is data-center GPU hardware, so a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers memory, performance, MIG, confidential computing, CUDA and NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM software, none of which is an assistant built into the product. NIM microservices and build.nvidia.com inference endpoints are building blocks for deploying models, not a delegating assistant, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
